items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: I have to say that during this time a new book came out by Royal Stokes, the author, and I have a pretty prominent place in it.

ctx.x: I have to say that during this time a new book came out by Royal Stokes, the author, and I have a pretty prominent place in it. He’s got several entries for me, not real short either, and pictures, a couple of pictures.
Oh great. I’ll look for it. What’s the name of it?

items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Royal Stokes has been a great promoter of women in jazz, including of my own career, doing as much as he could to recommend me to people.

ctx.x: That’s a different story, yeah. Well I’ve enjoyed talking to you today. Is there anything that you’d like to add on your own?

It just seems like in all those years, you know there’s so many different phases. I’ve had a lot of fun playing at some music festivals in U.K. and Switzerland and I’m looking into Germany now. There’s been so many different experiences. I guess you can’t cover it all in one interview, but I was pleased to be written up in several books. Royal Stokes has been a great promoter of women in jazz, including of my own career, doing as much as he could to recommend me to people.
Have you ever thought about relocating?
